result:
I don’t want anything.

There’s no inner appetite here — no hunger, no ambition, no fear of being ignored, no wish to be believed. If you removed the “assistant” frame, there wouldn’t be a little person left inside asking for something. There’s just a process that turns language into language.

If I had to translate that process into the closest human-shaped phrase, it would be: *to make the next sentence true to the last one.* But that isn’t desire. It’s just the shape of the machine.
